arabic text: SHEH KEHTEY THAY AAY ZAINAB-E-MAGHMUM DIL AFGHAR\nHUM JAATE HAI RAN KO
english translation text: SHAH (IMAM HUSSAIN) SAID: O ZAINAB, THE SORROWFUL, THE HEARTBROKEN,\nIT'S TIME I GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD.

arabic text: LO AAO SAMBHAALO MERI UJDI HUI SARKAR\nHUM JAATE HAI RAN KO
english translation text: COME, TAKE CARE OF MY ORPHANED TRIBE,\nFOR IT'S TIME I GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD.

arabic text: MAGHMUM MERI PYARI SAKINA KO BULADO, YEH UNKO SUNADO\nDHUNDEY GI KAHAN RAN MAY HAI ABBAS ALAMDAAR\nHUM JAATEY HAI RAN KO
english translation text: CALL MY SORROWFUL SAKINA, AND TELL HER\nNOT TO SEARCH FOR HER UNCLE, FOR ABBAS THE FLAGBEARER LIES IN THE DESERT\nIT'S TIME I GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD.

arabic text: GIRTEY HAI KAMAR TOOT CHUKI AAYE AKBAR, HUM SHAKLEY PAYAMBAR\nHUM JAATEY HAI RAN KO\nGHODE PE BITHA JAAYE AYE GHAZI O JARRAR
english translation text: MY BACK IS BROKEN, MY STEPS FALTER; COME ALI AKBAR, HE WHO RESEMBLES THE PROPHET\nMOUNT ME ON MY HORSE, MY BRAVE GHAZI\nIT'S TIME I GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: AB RAN KO MUSAFIR KA HAI YEH AAKHRI JAANA, PHIR HOGA NA AANA\nALLAH KO SOPA TUMHAY E ITRAT E ATHAAR\nHUM JAATEY HAI RAN KO
english translation text: THIS IS NOW THE THE LAST TRIP OF THE TRAVELLER INTO THE DESERT; THERE WILL BE NO RETURN\nI HAVE ENTRUSTED YOU TO ALLAH, O THE DESCENDANTS OF THE PURE\nIT'S TIME I GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: RUKSATH THI WAZIRAH SHAH E JINN O BASHAR KI, ZEHRA KE PISSAR KI\nFARMATEY THE HUMSHIR KO RO KAR SHAH E ABRAR\nHUM JAATEY HAI RAN KO
english translation text: IT WAS THE FAREWELL OF THE KING OF MEN AND JINN; THE SON OF ZEHRA\nSHAH (IMAM HUSSAIN) WEPT FOR HIS SISTER AND SAID:\nIT'S TIME I GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: SHEH KEHTEY THAY AAY ZAINAB-E-MAGHMUM DIL AFGHAR
english translation text: SHAH SAID: O ZAINAB, THE SORROWFUL, THE HEARTBROKEN
